svg.title: Dexterity Sheets
svg.desc: Your team's spreadsheet. Live, together, on the office network. A line list floats in 3D while Vikram, Anita Rao and Rahul Mehta edit it together; each change is written into the Edit History with their name.

g.text: Live, together, on the office network.
